build: Water and feed records, fertilizer stock and manual irrigation. New records require a grower action. Existing plans open without setup.

changes.did: Water shows fertility and irrigation by garden. Tasks records tank refills and Supplies tracks the fresh fertilizer used.
steps: On Water, choose a garden to log a field application, set nutrient targets or add a feed tank.
Request a refill and open Tasks. Check the recipe and batch size, then record the actual refill.
Set up a zone on Irrigation. Record a run here or from Tasks on a phone. Review disputed evidence for the selected period.
